usage: After operator review, save as literal_search.py and run with Python 3 on POSIX: python3 literal_search.py < input.json. Input example: {"root":"/approved/directory","query":"item-example","path":"."}. The operator must approve root; the input schema provides no separate approval registry. Searches recursively, including hidden files, with case-sensitive literal matching; returns one record per matching line, sorted by root-relative path and line number. Line text excludes line separators. Invalid UTF-8 files, symlinks encountered during recursion, and special files are skipped. Explicit symlink targets, parent traversal (including ../), missing paths, malformed inputs, and filesystem errors return {"error":"invalid_input"}; no matches returns {"matches":[]}. Uses descriptor-relative access without following descendant symlinks. Reads each file fully into memory. Source was not executed or validated against fixture contents; only the supplied contract and input metadata were available.
